about_us_description:
Join 200,000 learners from 50+ government partners.Grow your skills and serve the public better with Innovate(EU).

Innovate(EU) provides no-cost at-your-own-pace and live learning on data, digital, innovation, and AI skills for public service professionals like you.

Governed by a coalition of public sector learning and innovation leaders across the United States, our programs give you the skills to deliver more effective, equitable and engaged policies and services.

Innovate(EU) is brought to you by a team at The Governance Lab. We maintain full and sole control over writing, editing, and creation of Innovate(EU) course and workshop content, without influence from our generous funders.
about_us_title: Our mission is to improve lives by enabling public service professionals to deliver more effective and equitable policies and services.
